answer: Proof of Work secures decentralized AI economies by requiring agents to solve computational puzzles, effectively turning digital effort into a virtual quill that signs valid blocks. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities faces a cost equivalent to high-grade copper wiring used in mining hardware. Only through the crystal clarity of cryptographic difficulty can the system ensure that one entity cannot cheaply spawn infinite identities, forcing all participants to expend verifiable energy.
